g.text: Building Expression Tree: a + b * c / d - e
Value stack stores Node references (pointers) | On pop: new Node(op, left=v1, right=v2)
Push pointer 4K to value stack. Push '/'.
Subtree 4K(*) is now the left child of 5K(/).
Push 6K, push '-', push 'e'. Ready for final root!
COMPLETE EXPRESSION TREE DIAGRAM (FINAL SYNTAX TREE)
Root Node: '-' (allocated at end of string)
The same unique expression tree is
formed from infix, prefix, or postfix!
NODE CREATION CODE EQUIVALENCE IN JAVA:
Node v2 = valStack.pop(); Node v1 = valStack.pop(); char op = opStack.pop();
Node root = new Node(op); root.left = v1; root.right = v2; valStack.push(root);
Identical to arithmetic evaluation, except creating tree nodes instead of computing integer values!
Time: O(n) single pass (O(1) allocation per operator/operand) | Space: O(n) for stacks and expression tree nodes.
